cues.en: Hello, my friends, and welcome to this new hands-on tutorial on regression with SageMaker.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到 SageMaker 迴歸實作。

cues.en: In the previous tutorial, we just uploaded the two datasets for regression and classification.
cues.zh: 上一堂上傳迴歸、分類兩份資料。

cues.en: In this tutorial, we're gonna build the regression model, and in the next one, the classification model.
cues.zh: 這堂建迴歸，下一堂建分類。

cues.en: All right, so here we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Let's go to My Models.
cues.zh: 到 My models。

cues.en: That's indeed the feature of Canvas, allowing you to build machine learning models, including a regression or classification model.
cues.zh: 這是 Canvas 建立機器學習模型的功能，包括迴歸與分類。

cues.en: And as you can see here, that's the process.
cues.zh: 可以看到流程。

cues.en: You start by building the model, then you analyze the results, then you can make some predictions, and then eventually, you deploy it, but of course, that's gonna be for further sections of this course.
cues.zh: 先建立模型、分析結果、做預測，最後部署，但部署是後面章節。

cues.en: We won't go up to the deployment step, but we will definitely make some predictions.
cues.zh: 不做到部署，但一定會預測。

cues.en: Are you ready?
cues.zh: 準備好了嗎？

cues.en: Here we go, let's create a new model.
cues.zh: 建立新模型。

cues.en: Okay, so we're gonna call it, of course, regression model, right?
cues.zh: 當然叫 Regression model。

cues.en: Then we have to choose a problem type and we have the choice between predictive analysis, image analysis, text analysis, or fine-tune foundation model.
cues.zh: 再選問題類型，有 Predictive analysis、Image analysis、Text analysis、Fine-tune foundation model。

cues.en: Of course, we wanna make some predictions.
cues.zh: 當然要做預測。

cues.en: We wanna predict the net hourly electrical energy output of these combined cycle power plants, and so we keep that option and we click Create.
cues.zh: 預測複循環發電廠的每小時淨發電量，所以保留這個選項，按 Create。

cues.en: All right, it's gonna take us to the next step of the model creation process, which is to indeed select the dataset with which you're gonna train your regression model,
cues.zh: 下一步選訓練迴歸模型的資料集，

cues.en: and so of course, it's this one, Regression Dataset, which we imported in the previous tutorial, so let's click Select Dataset, and here we go.
cues.zh: 當然是上一堂匯入的 Regression dataset，按 Select dataset。

cues.en: We are in the build step as you can see.
cues.zh: 如你所見，目前在 Build 步驟。

cues.en: And our first step is to select the column to predict, meaning the dependent variable, also called the target column, and that, of course, the net hourly electrical energy output,
cues.zh: 首先選要預測的欄，依變數，也叫目標欄，當然是每小時淨發電量，

cues.en: which is the last one here, PE.
cues.zh: 也就是最後的 PE。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So, as you can see, automatically, the target was selected, and all the rest of the variables here are the features, meaning the independent variables with which you're gonna predict the dependent variable,
cues.zh: 目標已自動選取，其餘都是特徵、自變數，用來預測依變數，

cues.en: meaning the target, all right?
cues.zh: 也就是目標。

cues.en: So, first step down here to select the target, and now we have to configure the model, and you will see it's super interesting here.
cues.zh: 選目標完成，現在設定模型，這裡很有意思。

cues.en: And please focus now because I'm gonna show you a lot of things that can come up at the exam.
cues.zh: 請專注，因為要展示很多考試可能出現的項目。

cues.en: So, all the configuration we're gonna go through here, that can come up in the questions of the exam.
cues.zh: 接下來這些設定，都可能在考題裡。

cues.en: Okay, so here we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Let's click Configure model.
cues.zh: 按 Configure model。

cues.en: All right, so first, we have to choose the model type, and it's, of course, a numeric model type because we're doing regression, we're predicting a continuous numeric variable,
cues.zh: 先選模型類型，當然 Numeric，因為做迴歸，預測連續數值變數，

cues.en: so we just skip this.
cues.zh: 所以不改。

cues.en: And now, even if it's optional, we will go through all the advanced configuration here, starting with the objective metric.
cues.zh: 雖然選用，仍看全部進階設定，先從 Objective metric。

cues.en: So, the objective metric is the metric that you're gonna optimize, usually minimize through the training of your machine learning model, your regression.
cues.zh: 這是訓練模型時要最佳化、通常最小化的指標。

cues.en: And for regression, the different objective metrics are, first, MSE, which is the mean squared error, which is the mean of the squared differences between your predictions and the actual values.
cues.zh: 迴歸指標首先是 MSE，均方誤差，預測與實際差異平方的平均。

cues.en: As you can see here, the average of the squared differences between each prediction, its corresponding actual value.
cues.zh: 如這裡，每筆預測與實際值之差平方，再平均。

cues.en: And we have other ones like the RMSE, the second one, which is the root of the MSE, the root mean squared error.
cues.zh: 其他有 RMSE，也就是 MSE 開平方，均方根誤差。

cues.en: Or you also have the MAE, mean absolute error, so instead of taking the squares of the differences between the predictions and the actual values, you're gonna just take the absolute value
cues.zh: 也有 MAE，平均絕對誤差，不取預測與實際差值的平方，而取

cues.en: of the differences.
cues.zh: 差值的絕對值。

cues.en: And finally, we have R-squared, which is an excellent one as well, because as you can see, it tells you how well your prediction model fits the actual data and measures how closely your model's predictive values
cues.zh: 最後 R 平方也很好，因為能表示模型擬合實際資料的程度，衡量預測值

cues.en: approximate the true values, okay?
cues.zh: 多接近真值。

cues.en: So please remember this.
cues.zh: 請記住。

cues.en: These are the four types of objective metrics for regression.
cues.zh: 這是四種迴歸目標指標。

cues.en: And now, let's go to Training method and algorithms, and same, that can be part of the exam.
cues.zh: 再到 Training method and algorithms，同樣可能考。

cues.en: And so, we're not gonna leave it at Auto here because I don't want you to see only a black box, and so we're also gonna see what we have in Ensemble, this Ensemble option,
cues.zh: 不先保留 Auto，因為不希望只看到黑箱，也看看 Ensemble 選項，

cues.en: because that will allow you to see all the algorithms that you can select when building a regression model in SageMaker here in Canvas, okay?
cues.zh: 能看到在 SageMaker Canvas 建迴歸可選的演算法。

cues.en: So, first, and that's part of the exam, you have XGBoost.
cues.zh: 首先，可能會考的 XGBoost。

cues.en: You should know more or less what it is, a supervised learning algorithm that attempts to accurately predict the target variable by combining an ensemble of estimates from a set of simpler or weaker models.
cues.zh: 大概需要知道，它是監督式演算法，結合一組較簡單、較弱模型的估計，形成集成以預測目標。

cues.en: You have the linear models, such as linear regression.
cues.zh: 有線性模型，例如線性迴歸。

cues.en: LightGBM, that uses tree-based algorithms, gradient boosting, and histogram-based algorithms to optimize speed and memory usage.
cues.zh: LightGBM，使用樹型梯度提升與直方圖演算法，最佳化速度與記憶體使用。

cues.en: CatBoost, same, it uses tree-based algorithms with gradient boosting, and pretty well optimized for handling categorical variables.
cues.zh: CatBoost，同樣樹型梯度提升，尤其適合處理類別變數。

cues.en: That's something you should remember as well.
cues.zh: 這也要記得。

cues.en: Random forest, extra trees.
cues.zh: 隨機森林、極端隨機樹。

cues.en: And the neural networks, of course, either the ones built using PyTorch or the ones built using Fast.ai, okay?
cues.zh: 當然也有神經網路，使用 PyTorch 或 Fast.ai 建立。

cues.en: So, mostly remember these three gradient boosting algorithms here, XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost.
cues.zh: 主要記住三種梯度提升：XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost。

cues.en: This can come up at the exam.
cues.zh: 考試可能出現。

cues.en: And finally, you have the third option here, which is Hyperparameter optimization, which will tune the hyperparameters of your models during the training.
cues.zh: 第三個選項是 Hyperparameter optimization，會在訓練流程中調校超參數。

cues.en: And just know that the only models used for this particular option are XGBoost and multilayer perceptron, all right?
cues.zh: 只要知道，這個特定選項只使用 XGBoost 與多層感知器。

cues.en: Now, Data split.
cues.zh: 現在 Data split。

cues.en: Yes, that's a good training test set ratio.
cues.zh: 這是很好的訓練／測試比例。

cues.en: We're gonna have 80% of all our data points in the training set to train our regression model and then 20% in the validation set to test our model.
cues.zh: 80% 資料訓練，20% 驗證，測試模型。

cues.en: Okay, so no need to change anything here.
cues.zh: 不需要修改。

cues.en: And then Max candidates and run time, that's all right.
cues.zh: Max candidates and run time，這樣可以。

cues.en: This won't come up at the exam.
cues.zh: 這裡不會考。

cues.en: We can just leave what we have here, okay?
cues.zh: 保留現值。

cues.en: And that's it.
cues.zh: 就這樣。

cues.en: Now, just back to training method and algorithms, I'm gonna choose, of course, Auto because the training will be faster and also less costly, so make sure to pick Auto here,
cues.zh: 再回 Training method and algorithms，會選 Auto，因為訓練更快、費用更低，請選 Auto，

cues.en: and then we're gonna click Save.
cues.zh: 再按 Save。

cues.en: And my friends, we are now ready to build our regression model on our combined cycle power plant regression dataset.
cues.zh: 朋友們，現在可以用複循環發電廠資料建立迴歸模型。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: We're gonna choose the Quick build option, but just so you know, you also have the Standard build option, which will choose accuracy over speed.
cues.zh: 選 Quick build，但也有 Standard build，它優先準確率而非速度。

cues.en: Basically, your machine learning mode will end up being more accurate, but just for educational purposes, we're gonna choose Quick build here 'cause not only it'll be faster and also less costly.
cues.zh: 基本上結果可能更準確，但教學選 Quick build，不只快，也便宜。

cues.en: All right, here we go, three, two, one, and go.
cues.zh: 三、二、一，開始。

cues.en: Quick build, pre-processing your dataset.
cues.zh: Quick build，前處理資料集。

cues.en: This can take a few minutes.
cues.zh: 可能幾分鐘。

cues.en: You can navigate away from this page.
cues.zh: 可以離開這頁。

cues.en: This won't interrupt the process.
cues.zh: 不會中斷。

cues.en: Indeed, it will first pre-process the dataset, even though it's already pre-processed.
cues.zh: 先前處理，即使資料已經處理好。

cues.en: There is no, you know, missing value or outliers or things to do.
cues.zh: 沒有缺失值、離群值或其他需處理內容。

cues.en: That's because we already did it in the previous section.
cues.zh: 因為先前已做。

cues.en: But you know, it will still go through your dataset, check that everything is right, and there we go.
cues.zh: 但仍會檢查資料是否正確。

cues.en: Now, the model is training, and it's gonna take between 2 to 15 minutes because it's the Quick build option.
cues.zh: 現在訓練中，Quick build 大約 2 到 15 分鐘。

cues.en: And you will see a series of steps happening here while the training happens.
cues.zh: 訓練時會看到一連串步驟。

cues.en: And in a couple of minutes, we will finally get our model ready to make predictions, so I'll see you soon once it's ready.
cues.zh: 幾分鐘後模型就能預測，準備好再見。

cues.en: And here we go, it's already finished.
cues.zh: 好了，已完成。

cues.en: It actually took three minutes for me.
cues.zh: 我實際用了三分鐘。

cues.en: Probably the same for you because the dataset is not that big, so perfect.
cues.zh: 你應該差不多，資料不大，很好。

cues.en: I'm gonna close this.
cues.zh: 關閉這裡。

cues.en: This is just a survey.
cues.zh: 只是問卷。

cues.en: And we end up with an RMSE, root mean squared error, of 2.943 and an R-squared of 0.970, which is really good.
cues.zh: 最後 RMSE 為 2.943，R 平方 0.970，非常好。

cues.en: And remember that we chose the optimization metric to be R-squared, and so that was the one that was optimized, okay?
cues.zh: 記得選的最佳化指標是 R 平方，所以最佳化的是它。

cues.en: And we also see the column impact, meaning the feature impacts, the feature impacting the most, the target, meaning the net hourly electrical energy output, is the ambient temperature with 60.4% impact.
cues.zh: 也能看到欄位影響，特徵對目標每小時淨發電量的影響，最大是環境溫度，60.4%。

cues.en: Then comes the exhaust vacuum, 26.6% impact.
cues.zh: 接著排氣真空度 26.6%。

cues.en: Ambient pressure, 7%.
cues.zh: 環境壓力 7%。

cues.en: Relative humidity, 6%, okay?
cues.zh: 相對濕度 6%。

cues.en: Then you can have a look at the scoring with the graph of the actual values of the net hourly electrical energy output, meaning the target with respect to the predicted values of the target.
cues.zh: Scoring 可以看目標淨發電量實際值與預測值的圖。

cues.en: And as you can see, the model often predicts a value that is within plus or minus 2.943, the RMSE of the actual value for the target PE.
cues.zh: 模型預測通常在實際 PE 值上下 2.943，也就是 RMSE 附近。

cues.en: And if you go to Advanced metrics, you can see more, like the metrics table with the values of the other metrics, mean absolute error of 2.099, mean squared error of 8.659,
cues.zh: Advanced metrics 可看其他值，MAE = 2.099、MSE = 8.659，

cues.en: RMSE, and R-squared, okay?
cues.zh: 還有 RMSE、R 平方。

cues.en: These are the residuals, meaning the differences of the actual values and predicted values with respect to the predicted values and the error density, all right?
cues.zh: 這是殘差，實際與預測差值對預測值的圖，以及誤差密度。

cues.en: So, now, here we go for the other fun part, predict the target values.
cues.zh: 接著有趣的部分，預測目標。

cues.en: And so, when you make predictions at this step, you have the choice between making batch predictions, if you have, for example, another dataset of many data points, but without the target, meaning the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 這裡可以批次預測，例如有另一份多筆資料、但沒目標依變數的資料集。

cues.en: Or you can also make single prediction, and that's what we're gonna do.
cues.zh: 也可以單筆預測，我們就做這個。

cues.en: It's super easy.
cues.zh: 非常簡單。

cues.en: We just have to enter the values here of the features, meaning the four independent variables, AT, V, AP, and RH, and then we'll get the prediction of the net hourly electrical energy output,
cues.zh: 只輸入四個自變數 AT、V、AP、RH 的值，就能得到每小時淨發電量預測，

cues.en: and so, well, let's change a bit the values here.
cues.zh: 稍微改些值。

cues.en: We're gonna just round it down, 25 for the ambient temperature, then 41 for the exhaust vacuum, then 1013 for the ambient pressure,
cues.zh: 直接取整數，環境溫度 25、排氣真空度 41、環境壓力 1013，

cues.en: and 100 for the relative humidity, okay?
cues.zh: 相對濕度 100。

cues.en: That was the prediction of the net hourly electrical energy output for the four values we just had before, before changing them.
cues.zh: 目前那個預測，是修改前四個特徵值的預測。

cues.en: And to get the prediction for these feature values, well, you just need to click Update prediction and you will get the new prediction of the net hourly electrical energy output,
cues.zh: 要對新值預測，只按 Update prediction，就得到新的淨發電量，

cues.en: which will be PE equal 448.966.
All right, as simple as that.
cues.zh: 就是這麼簡單。

cues.en: And now for the deployment, we'll see that in a further section.
cues.zh: 部署後面章節再看。

cues.en: So, let's take a break now.
cues.zh: 先休息。

cues.en: That was some good work done on regression, and now I can't wait to see you in the next tutorial to build the classification model.
cues.zh: 迴歸做得很好，迫不及待下一堂建立分類模型。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
